task: Issue #11 slice: standalone opt-in temporary-file storage I/O benchmark CLI (write+fsync/read, size bounded, POSIX temporary file cleanup, buffered/cache limitations explicitly recorded, no new IPC or cache mutation).

events.summary: Implement standalone opt-in storage I/O benchmark CLI under scripts/mlx/storage_benchmark.py, unit tests under tests/mlx/test_storage_benchmark.py, Makefile storage-benchmark target, and docs/06-mlops-user-guide.md. Exclude GPU benchmark card UI/IPC, MLflow export, and shared model-cache manipulation per approved slice.

Issue #11 previously implemented GPU matmul benchmark and UI while explicitly deferring storage/cache I/O; scripts/mlx/storage_benchmark.py and tests/mlx/test_storage_benchmark.py were missing from the repo, preventing independent verification of filesystem write+fsync/read throughput with bounded temporary files.

Added scripts/mlx/storage_benchmark.py with 1-256 MiB bounded temporary file I/O, os.fsync timing, buffered/cache limitation disclosure, and D22-compliant JSON error reporting; added tests/mlx/test_storage_benchmark.py covering size bounds, chunking, directory validation, mock/live I/O failures, cleanup, and subprocess execution; updated Makefile and docs/06-mlops-user-guide.md.

python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/mlx -v passed 23 tests (including 11 storage benchmark tests covering argument validation, real file write+fsync/read, cleanup, I/O errors, and subprocess execution); cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --lib passed isolated regression checks; cargo fmt --check passed; cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings passed with 0 warnings; pnpm exec tsc --noEmit passed with 0 errors.

Executed standalone storage benchmark via make -s storage-benchmark STORAGE_BENCH_ARGS='--directory /tmp --size-mib 1' and python3 -B scripts/mlx/storage_benchmark.py returning status ok with real write_fsync and read timings; make verify completed successfully with all test suites passing.
Benchmarks were run against macOS local temporary filesystem (/private/tmp); cold disk / unbuffered direct I/O and shared cache eviction were intentionally not performed per benchmark limitations.
Standalone opt-in storage I/O benchmark CLI, comprehensive unit tests, Makefile recipe, and user documentation are complete, verified by unit tests, static checks, runtime execution, and make verify.
Complete and verified across unit tests, runtime small-size execution, clippy, tsc, and make verify.
